_comment: Static overlay map for Harvest Moon: Back to Nature (SLUS-01115).
Facts recovered by decompiling the game's own archive loader. Everything
here is metadata ABOUT the disc, never content FROM it: the disc supplies
the bytes at build time via tools/extract_overlays.py.
The game ships one archive, \A_FILE.BIN, indexed by \A_FILE.HDT (132
bytes = 33 little-endian u32 byte offsets, monotonic, 0x800-aligned; the
last entry equals A_FILE.BIN's total size). Member i spans
HDT[i] .. HDT[i+1].
FUN_800147bc reads the HDT and scatters its offsets into a static 33-record
table at 0x80048B40 (stride 0x28, field 0 = offset, field 2.. = ASCII path),
then resolves A_FILE.BIN's base LBA via CdSearchFile.
FUN_800145f0(start_idx, end_idx, dest, dest) is the load primitive:
LBA   = (table[start] >> 11) + base_lba
count = (table[end] >> 11) - (table[start] >> 11) + ((table[end] & 0x7FF) ? 1 : 0)
Callers always pass end = start + 1, so a load is exactly one member.
The destination is a caller argument and is always one of two constants
held in the executable, so overlays occupy two mutually exclusive windows.
FUN_80011370 (the main loop) selects member + window + entry point with a
switch on the game mode at 0x8005E39C; it stores the overlay's entry point
into 0x8005E384 before dispatching.
Verified: member 11 (objcg\event_s.bin) extracted from disc matches a live
RAM capture of 0x800B7E20 byte-for-byte across its entire code region; the
only 722 differing bytes lie past file offset 0x06B168, in trailing data
mutated at runtime. No load-time relocation is applied, so a disc image is
the pristine loaded form.
See docs/SESSION-02.md for the derivation.

A.note: immediately after BSS end (0x800B7E20); the ~1 MB region the runtime already tracks as 0x800B7000

B.note: overlaps the tail of member 11 when that member is loaded into window A

members.note: named NOTHING in the record table, but a real 4 KB overlay with a real entry point

mode 15 loads member 11 into window B rather than A, unlike every other reference to it, and records no entry point. Either a mode that relocates it or a game bug — not yet chased. Extracted anyway: an overlay whose bytes never match RAM is dead weight in the cache, never a correctness risk.
